extracted.name: Low-Cal Chicken
extracted.description: This reduced-calorie baked chicken is made with artificial sweetener, soy sauce, onion, garlic, and spices.
ingredient_lines: 4 (4 ounce) skinless, boneless chicken breast halves
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F (220 degrees C).
Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish; sprinkle with onion, garlic, seasoning, soy sauce and sweetener.
Place foil over pan and bake for one hour at 425 degrees F (220 degrees C). It's ready to serve!
